git add -A crates/local_inference && git commit -q -m "local_inference: harden the OpenAI Responses stream parser

- Take a function call's whole arguments from output_item.added/.done, so
  a Responses-compatible server that never streams argument deltas still
  produces a usable tool call. The finished item restarts the call, which
  replaces any fragments that did arrive.
- Show response.refusal.delta as text instead of ending the turn silently.
- Separate consecutive reasoning summary parts with a blank line.
- Read an error event whose fields are nested under \`error\` (the ChatGPT
  backend), and give a failed response without an error object a message.
- Send input messages with an explicit type: message, which stricter
  compatible servers require." && gh auth switch -u wynn5a && git push -q origin master; gh auth switch -u fuwenming-pacvue && gh auth status 2>&1 | grep -i active -B1 | head -4; git log --oneline -1
